test: device Settings completes a member login, shows activity, invites and switches without signing in again
expected: the Jevellan web app "join" screen at phone-dark, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "device Settings completes a member login, shows activity, invites and switches without signing in again"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The Join code field is a solid light-gray box with no visible text. It is probably masked on purpose because the code is a secret, but on its own it looks like an empty bright input sitting on a dark theme.
A light box covers the end of the command (the token part). It also looks like intentional masking.
The command wraps in the middle of the URL ('htt' / 'p://127.0.0.1:30774'), which is harder to read. Breaking at word boundaries or allowing horizontal scroll would help.
The dimmed page behind the modal shows a little through the backdrop, but it doesn't get in the way of the modal content.
